name: faulty-terminal
title: Faulty Terminal
description: A flickering CRT terminal of glowing glyphs, with phosphor trails under the cursor and glitches on click.

files.content:
import type { FaultyTerminalLook, FaultyTerminalPreset } from './types';

const FAULTY_TERMINAL_LOOK: FaultyTerminalLook = {
  tint: '#A7EF9E',
  glyphs: 'blocks',
  scale: 1.5,
  digitSize: 1.2,
  timeScale: 0.5,
  brightness: 0.75,
  glow: 0.5,
  persistence: 0.5,
  mouseStrength: 0.5,
  mouseGlow: 0.6,
  scramble: 0.5,
  scanlineIntensity: 0.5,
  glitchAmount: 1,
  flickerAmount: 1,
  noiseAmp: 1,
  chromaticAberration: 0,
  curvature: 0.1,
  vignette: 0.25,
  clickEffect: 'glitch',
  lightMode: false,
};

const FAULTY_TERMINAL_PRESETS: Record<
  FaultyTerminalPreset,
  Partial<FaultyTerminalLook>
> = {
  phosphor: {},
  classic: {
    brightness: 0.6,
    glow: 0,
    persistence: 0,
    mouseGlow: 0,
    vignette: 0,
    clickEffect: 'none',
  },
  terminal: {
    glyphs: 'characters',
    tint: '#B8F5A8',
    scale: 1.2,
    digitSize: 1.15,
    brightness: 0.85,
    scramble: 0.6,
  },
  amber: {
    glyphs: 'dots',
    tint: '#FFB347',
    scale: 1.6,
    digitSize: 1.25,
    brightness: 0.8,
    glow: 0.6,
    clickEffect: 'degauss',
  },
  ice: {
    tint: '#7DD3FC',
    scale: 2.2,
    digitSize: 1.3,
    timeScale: 0.35,
    brightness: 0.85,
    glow: 0.7,
    persistence: 0.85,
    mouseGlow: 0.8,
  },
  meltdown: {
    tint: '#F4F4F5',
    scale: 1.3,
    timeScale: 0.8,
    brightness: 0.7,
    glitchAmount: 3,
    flickerAmount: 2,
    noiseAmp: 1.3,
    chromaticAberration: 1.5,
    curvature: 0.25,
    vignette: 0.45,
  },
  data: {
    glyphs: 'characters',
    tint: '#E4E4E7',
    scale: 2.4,
    digitSize: 1.1,
    brightness: 0.7,
    glow: 0.35,
    scramble: 0.9,
    curvature: 0,
  },
};

/** Light-page variants: ink colors that print clearly on white. */
const FAULTY_TERMINAL_LIGHT_SWAP: Record<
  FaultyTerminalPreset,
  Partial<FaultyTerminalLook>
> = {
  phosphor: { lightMode: true, tint: '#166534', brightness: 0.6 },
  classic: { lightMode: true, tint: '#166534', brightness: 0.55 },
  terminal: { lightMode: true, tint: '#166534', brightness: 0.75 },
  amber: { lightMode: true, tint: '#B45309', brightness: 0.7 },
  ice: { lightMode: true, tint: '#0369A1', brightness: 0.7 },
  meltdown: { lightMode: true, tint: '#18181B', brightness: 0.6 },
  data: { lightMode: true, tint: '#18181B', brightness: 0.6 },
};

/** Full set of visual props for a preset, optionally in its light variant. */
export function faultyTerminalPreset(
  preset: FaultyTerminalPreset,
  light = false,
): FaultyTerminalLook {
  return {
    ...FAULTY_TERMINAL_LOOK,
    ...FAULTY_TERMINAL_PRESETS[preset],
    ...(light ? FAULTY_TERMINAL_LIGHT_SWAP[preset] : {}),
  };
}
